summary: This note describes Savoonga Airport, a state-owned public-use airport in Alaska. It lies two nautical miles (4 km) south of the central business district of Savoonga, a city in the Nome Census Area. The note also places Savoonga on St. Lawrence Island in the Bering Sea.
one_line: Savoonga Airport is a state-owned public-use airport two nautical miles south of Savoonga, on St. Lawrence Island in Alaska.
key_facts: Savoonga Airport is a state-owned public-use airport.
Savoonga Airport is located two nautical miles (4 km) south of the central business district of Savoonga.
Savoonga is a city in the Nome Census Area of the U.S. state of Alaska.
Savoonga is located on St. Lawrence Island.
St. Lawrence Island lies in the Bering Sea.
